Reader featChoicePrompt, called from src/builder/Builder.tsx:429,442,460,481,484-485,577,600,638. "Difficult terrain" matches the shipped sibling underbrush-trailblazer. value.when: while undetected by all non-allies in your chosen difficult terrain, if you move no more than 5 feet and do not pass within 10 feet of an enemy during your movement
value.bonus: Sneak without attempting a Stealth check

value.when: during exploration, while Avoiding their Notice in your chosen difficult terrain, as long as they aren't actively Searching or on guard
value.bonus: automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures

why: Printed, verbatim: "While undetected by all non-allies in that type of terrain, you can Sneak without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than 5 feet and do not pass within 10 feet of an enemy during your movement." and "During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures while Avoiding their Notice, as long as they aren't actively Searching or on guard." WG attaches exactly these two clauses via two injectText ops per option — a SHEET surface. Today the feat has NO surface: no FEAT_SITUATIONAL key, no CHOICE_SITUATIONAL, no situational in core.json — while terrain-scout, which grants it, already carries a Stealth star about Terrain Stalker. Readers: src/rules/explain.ts:408 (authoredSituational) and src/sheet/StatDetailModal.tsx:109. Stealth target on the shooters-camouflage precedent. No number moves. No situationalReplaces — nothing shipped to replace.

value.when: to Hide and Sneak in natural terrain
to Sense Direction in natural terrain

why: Printed: "You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Hide and Sneak in natural terrain, and a +1 circumstance bonus to Sense Direction in natural terrain." Two bonuses, each naming its own actions. Our shipped entry src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:500 FUSES them into one entry targeting stealth AND survival with when "to Hide, Sneak, and Sense Direction in natural terrain", so the Survival star promises a bonus on Stealth actions and vice versa. WG splits it (SKILL_STEALTH +1 "to Hide and Sneak in natural terrain"; SKILL_SURVIVAL +1 "to Sense Direction in natural terrain"). Adopt theirs. Readers src/rules/explain.ts:408 and src/sheet/StatDetailModal.tsx:109. situationalReplaces is DERIVED by the applier (wilderness-born is in the shipped table), so entriesFor returns the authored pair INSTEAD of the fused one.

value.note: While in natural terrain, you're always considered to be Covering Tracks, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode.

why: Printed third clause verbatim. We encode nothing for it; WG carries it as a separate injectText beside the two skill bonuses. It changes an ACTION, not a stat, and explain.ts:570-575 states a clause naming no stat can never display through situational. Reader src/rules/explain.ts:366 (recordMarksFor), merged at explain.ts:584. Target verified: core.json actions has id "cover-tracks" (a Survival action per src/rules/actions.ts:101), found by actionSlug at src/sheet/StatDetailModal.tsx:185. No RECORD_MARKERS entry exists, so nothing duplicates. value omitted — no changed number. Note does not open with the record's own name (all three renderers prefix it).

value.when: to your defenses against Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks (the Perception DC or Will DC the creature rolls against)

why: Printed: "You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your defenses against Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks." ONE undivided clause. Our shipped FEAT_SITUATIONAL entry (src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:2208) splits it — Perception only vs Deception, Will only vs the other three, truncated with an ellipsis. WG attaches the SAME undivided trigger to both stats (PERCEPTION +1 and SAVE_WILL +1, identical text), so only the scoping disagrees; adopt their scoping. The DC framing is KEPT because WG encodes nothing about roll-vs-DC (carve-out 1) and printed "defenses" means the DC. dcOnly deliberately not introduced. One entry with two targets renders on BOTH stats (featSituationalFor uses targets.find, hasFeatSituational uses targets.some — situationalBonuses.ts:3304, 3772); shipped idiom at situationalBonuses.ts:125 (ancestral-suspicion). situationalReplaces derived by the applier.

value: Not tracked: your draconic benefactor. The breath is a 30-foot line or a 15-foot cone dealing 1d4 damage, increasing by 1d4 at 3rd level and every 2 levels after; each creature in the area attempts a basic saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Which of the two shapes it takes, its damage type, and which save it calls for all match your draconic benefactor, and the Draconic Benefactors table is not in this data source — read all three off that table.
why: PARTIAL — a disclosure, not the mechanic; the lane is filed as a gap. Printed (verified against AoN feat-8068 in the local archive, because the shipped copy is corrupted to "manifests as a or a , dealing damage"): shape/damage type/save all match your draconic benefactor, damage 1d4 +1d4 every 2 levels, basic save vs the higher of class or spell DC. WG spends its whole encoding on that conditional — 40 conditional/injectText pairs keyed on DRACONIC_EXEMPLAR_NAME. We encode none of it and the Draconic Benefactors table is absent from our data (categoryPage/draconic-benefactors is a name-only stub). Their JSON is the only accessible source for the table and it is GPL-3.0, so the values cannot be adopted. dataWarning is the field built for this: declared src/rules/types.ts:1122, collected for any owned feat at src/rules/build.ts:4675, rendered in the Missing data banner at src/sheet/FeatsTab.tsx:326-337. House voice matches feats/miraculous-flight.

Printed: "You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against morph and polymorph effects, and if you roll a success on a saving throw against a hostile morph or polymorph effect, you get a critical success instead." Does not touch the success→critical-success clause, already ours as degreeShifts. situationalReplaces derived by the applier.

Not degreeShifts: that shift union (situationalBonuses.ts:3187) has no "success result AND critical-failure result at once" member. Prose-only bonus on a skill star has precedent (all-of-the-animal). Readers src/rules/explain.ts:408, src/sheet/StatDetailModal.tsx:109.

why: Printed verbatim. WE SHIP NOTHING: core.json carries only level/category/traits/prerequisites/actionCost, and grep of src/ for 'ongoing-selfishness|selfish-shield' returns ZERO lines. Not situational (SituationalTarget has no 'resistance' member); not an IwrEntry (that would print a permanent-looking line for a once-per-turn rider).
